about: Rename a product everywhere in release notes (word, possessive, lowercase command) and lose nothing else.
good:
# Inkwell 0.4 release notes

Inkwell now starts in 2.1 seconds, down from 3.4. Run `inkwell --doctor` to check your setup, or read https://example.com/docs/setup first.

- Inkwell's gate library has 23 blueprints.
- The installer asks for {licence_key} once.

Thanks to the 14 testers who tried Inkwell this month.
